Manipulates events and other calendar data.

Usage: gws [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  +insert       [Helper] create a new event
  +agenda       [Helper] Show upcoming events across all calendars
  acl           Operations on the 'acl' resource
  calendarList  Operations on the 'calendarList' resource
  calendars     Operations on the 'calendars' resource
  channels      Operations on the 'channels' resource
  colors        Operations on the 'colors' resource
  events        Operations on the 'events' resource
  freebusy      Operations on the 'freebusy' resource
  settings      Operations on the 'settings' resource
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
